fomod.Name: Fitting Room
fomod.Author: Mern
fomod.Description: ESO-style transmog for the player and followers. Armor, shields, weapons, hairstyle and hair colour, plus eyes, brows, facial hair, overlays and makeup on the player, worn as a pure appearance layer over your real gear: stats, enchantments and weight never change. Dye pieces one by one, save colour schemes, earn colours by playing, and write rules that switch your look on their own. One build for Skyrim SE 1.5.97 and AE 1.6.1130+.
